memory_update.text: KRT is the cleanest underfollowed US-listed small-cap candidate for the restaurant packaging/disposables node because its filings directly describe disposable foodservice products used in restaurant settings.

GPK should be tracked as a mid-cap paperboard foodservice packaging supplier with QSR-linked cups, lids and containers, but restaurant exposure must be separated from broader consumer-packaging exposure.

REYN is a secondary/indirect candidate through Hefty Tableware and non-retail foodservice aluminum sales; require proof that restaurant/catering channels are material rather than primarily retail household demand.
PFGC is best used as a distributor-channel reference for disposables, cleaning and kitchen supplies sold into restaurants rather than as a pure packaging/disposables supplier.

Pactiv Evergreen would have been a major public foodservice-packaging reference, but it became private/delisted after the Novolex transaction closed on April 1, 2025; do not include PTVE in live public-universe screens.

node: Restaurant supplies, packaging, tableware, napkins, cups, and disposables
summary: Layer 1B expands the public universe for restaurant supplies, foodservice packaging, tableware, cups, containers, napkins and disposables. The cleanest underfollowed public exposure found in this pass is Karat Packaging, a small-cap manufacturer/distributor of disposable foodservice products used by restaurants. Graphic Packaging and Reynolds Consumer Products add mid-cap exposure to paperboard foodservice packaging and disposable tableware, but their restaurant linkage is less pure and requires segment/end-market verification. Performance Food Group is included as a reference distributor/channel anchor because it distributes disposables, cleaning and kitchen supplies to restaurants, but it is not a pure packaging supplier and has higher analyst attention. Pactiv Evergreen/Novolex is important industry context but is excluded as a candidate because Pactiv Evergreen was delisted after Novolex completed its acquisition on April 1, 2025.
